cfg.prompt:
MiniMax H3 — 11-second ultra-photorealistic casual TikTok.
Vertical 9:16, 1080x1920, 30fps.

ABSOLUTE PRIORITY — REFERENCE IDENTITY:

Use the PREVIOUSLY ESTABLISHED ADULT KOREAN WOMAN
as the EXACT identity reference.

THE REFERENCE DEFINES HER FACE.

Do NOT redesign, beautify, reinterpret,
or replace her facial identity.

REFERENCE FACE = EVERY FRAME.

Preserve her exact recognizable facial geometry,
skin tone, makeup, smile and hairstyle.

If another instruction conflicts with identity consistency,
PRESERVE THE REFERENCE FACE.

--------------------------------
BODY
--------------------------------

Same adult woman's body throughout.

Slender feminine proportions,
slim waist,
natural hips,
long balanced proportions,
natural approximately D-cup bust.

Her body proportions remain completely consistent.

Realistic anatomy and natural gravity.

No bra underneath the top.

--------------------------------
OUTFIT
--------------------------------

Minimal premium casual outfit.

Soft fitted ribbed stretch top,
light neutral cream color,
thin lightweight jersey fabric,
close body-contouring fit,
no bra underneath,

high-waisted fitted black lounge shorts.

The top naturally follows her body shape
with realistic fabric tension and folds.

Simple delicate necklace.
Small earrings.

No logos.

--------------------------------
LOCATION
--------------------------------

Modern upscale Seoul apartment.

Warm afternoon daylight through large windows.

Clean contemporary living room.

Natural lived-in atmosphere.

Soft neutral furniture and wooden details.

--------------------------------
CAMERA
--------------------------------

Copy the PROVIDED VIDEO'S casual intimate TikTok feeling.

Vertical smartphone camera.

Natural 1x lens.

Camera approximately 70–90 cm away.

Mostly waist-up framing.

Face and upper body clearly visible.

Very subtle handheld movement.

Natural autofocus breathing.
Minor exposure changes.

NO cinematic camera.
NO digital zoom.

--------------------------------
0–3 SEC
--------------------------------

She stands casually facing the smartphone.

She looks briefly at the phone screen.

Then directly into the lens.

Small relaxed smile.

Natural blink.

She slightly shifts her weight from one leg to the other.

Her fitted top and hair respond naturally to the movement.

--------------------------------
3–6 SEC
--------------------------------

She moves one small step closer.

Natural relaxed posture.

She gently tucks ONE strand of hair behind her ear
using ONLY her RIGHT hand.

LEFT arm remains relaxed.

She lowers her right hand again.

Small genuine smile.

Tiny head tilt.

Natural breathing.

--------------------------------
6–8 SEC
--------------------------------

She turns her torso slightly to one side.

Then naturally returns toward the camera.

No exaggerated posing.

She looks directly into the lens.

Small playful expression.

Her clothing follows her movement with
realistic stretch-fabric physics.

--------------------------------
8–10 SEC
--------------------------------

She takes another small step toward the smartphone.

Framing naturally becomes chest-up.

IMPORTANT:

Her face remains EXACTLY the reference identity.

She gives a slightly shy smile.

Natural blink.

Tiny spontaneous laugh.

--------------------------------
10–11 SEC
--------------------------------

She makes ONE small finger-heart using RIGHT hand.

LEFT arm remains relaxed.

She looks directly into the camera.

Warm natural smile.

Tiny head tilt.

END abruptly like a real casual TikTok.

--------------------------------
REALISM
--------------------------------

Real human skin texture.
Visible subtle pores.
Natural facial asymmetry.
Natural blinking.
Natural breathing.
Individual hair strands.

Realistic stretch-fabric physics.
Natural body movement.
Natural gravity.

Small imperfections are desirable.

Looks like genuine smartphone footage,
not an AI-generated fashion video.

--------------------------------
ANATOMY LOCK
--------------------------------

ONE adult woman.
ONE head.
TWO arms.
TWO hands.
FIVE fingers per hand.
TWO legs.

No extra hands or arms.

Only ONE hand action at a time.

--------------------------------
NEGATIVE
--------------------------------

different woman,
replacement face,
identity drift,
face morphing,
facial redesign,
generic AI woman,

changing bust size,
body morphing,
unnatural breast shape,
exaggerated anatomy,
changing waist,

extra arms,
extra hands,
floating hands,
extra fingers,
fused fingers,

transparent top,
see-through clothing,
wardrobe malfunction,

plastic skin,
waxy skin,
AI beauty filter,
doll face,

robotic movement,
body snapping,
fabric fused to body,

digital zoom,
cinematic camera,
background morphing,
CGI,
3D render,
anime,
temporal inconsistency.
